thread:
anya_support: FYI ticket #INC-8421 — ACME hitting a spike, lots of 5xx/504 gateway timeouts. Customer timeline attached. They say errors started after a marketing blast at ~13:02 UTC.

mike_sre: on it. can you drop the request IDs & gateway logs? also which model/route?

anya_support: request ids: rq_8f3a, rq_8f3b, rq_8f3c. route: /v1/generate (hosted, model=redwood-3b). gateway logs show repeated 504s. pod logs show readiness probes passing later than expected — model init stalls for ~15s.

sam_prodeng: paste of kube events and scaledobject annotations from the tenant namespace:
```
ScaledObject acme-gen scaledTo: 0
annotations:
  keda.sh/cooldownPeriod: "600"
  redwood.com/prewarm: "false"
Events:
  13:01:58 - metric value spike detected
  13:02:00 - ScaledObject: scaling to 4
  13:02:05 - HPA: no scale (cooldown)
  13:02:12 - requests start 504ing
  13:02:28 - pod-xyz becomes ready
  13:02:45 - errors stop
```

lina_devex: who changed cooldown to 600s? that seems high. we usually set 30-60s for bursty tenants.

k8s-bot: Alert: HPA/Cooldown gating - last scale event < 10m ago, suppression active.

mike_sre: summary so far: KEDA triggered scale but HPA/cooldown annotations prevented pod count from stepping fast enough. when pods started they took ~20s to become ready because model init + KV cache warm. net result: gateway timed out in the gap.

anya_support: customer repro steps if you want to run:
1) from external net, hammer /v1/generate with 200 concurrent connections (tenant header X-Tenant: acme)
2) expect majority to 504s for the first ~20s
curl example:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do \
  curl -s -H 'X-Tenant: acme' -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
 done; wait
```

sam_prodeng: mitigation options:
- short-term: bump prewarm replicas for acme to 3 and set redwood.com/prewarm: "true" on their deployment (instant mitigation)
- medium: lower keda.sh/cooldownPeriod to 30s for bursty tenants
- long-term: introduce a lightweight fast-init binary that responds to readiness before full model KV warm to avoid 15-20s cold-init gap

mike_sre: agree. also add a fallback model route (smaller distilled variant) for initial 30s to avoid 5xx spikes.

lina_devex: i'm drafting a PR to auto-detect tenants with bursty patterns and recommend cooldown <60s and prewarm enabled. will include a safety check so we don't over-provision.

paul_oncall: I'll do the emergency mitigation: applying prewarm=true + set replicas=3 in prod for acme now. will monitor.

paul_oncall: applied changes at 13:12 UTC. Observability dashboard now shows spike handled and 5xxs dropped to 0 after ramp.

anya_support: customer notified and confirmed latency improved. they still want a postmortem and a plan to prevent recurrence.

mike_sre: action items:
- (sam) patch scaledobject defaults & add recommended cooldown for bursty tenants (PR + rollout)
- (lina) feature to auto-suggest prewarm based on tenant telemetry
- (prodeng) implement fallback distilled model routing policy for warmup window
- (oncall) add alert for queue depth + pending scale ops so we catch the gap sooner

lina_devex: I'll write the postmortem skeleton and tag owners.

anya_support: thanks all. customer happy for now :thumbsup:

k8s-bot: Note: follow-up reminder scheduled in 72h for RCA and config rollout.
